user.description: Choose the SP110E controller to add.

bluetooth_confirm.description: Set up {name}? Close the LED Hue app on your phone first: the controller accepts only one connection at a time.

manual.description: No SP110E found automatically. Enter its Bluetooth address (e.g. 65:56:04:0A:1E:B5). It must be within range of Home Assistant's Bluetooth or an ESPHome Bluetooth proxy.

abort.no_devices_found: No SP110E controllers found. Make sure it is powered and within range of a Bluetooth adapter or ESPHome Bluetooth proxy.

error.invalid_address: Not a valid Bluetooth address (format AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF).
error.not_in_range: Home Assistant can't see this address right now. Check that the controller is powered and in range.
